name: search_products
description: Find catalogue products for a need. Fill heads with the product type in Finnish base form and exclude with words to drop; put diet needs in must_claims and must_not_allergens. Diet filters are applied by the gateway.

query.description: The buyer's need in their own words, Finnish or English.

heads.description: Product-type heads the name must end with, in Finnish base form, e.g. ['maito', 'maitojuoma'].

items.description: One item of: Product-type heads the name must end with, in Finnish base form, e.g. ['maito', 'maitojuoma'].

exclude.description: Words that must not appear in the name, e.g. ['kaakao', 'jäätelö'].

items.description: One item of: Words that must not appear in the name, e.g. ['kaakao', 'jäätelö'].

must_claims.description: GS1 claims every result must carry, e.g. ['FREE_FROM_LACTOSE'].

items.description: One item of: GS1 claims every result must carry, e.g. ['FREE_FROM_LACTOSE'].

must_not_allergens.description: GS1 allergen codes every result must be free of, e.g. ['AM'] for milk.

items.description: One item of: GS1 allergen codes every result must be free of, e.g. ['AM'] for milk.

limit.description: Maximum number of products to return. Default: 10.
